OPERATIONS
==========

POWER ON/OFF
------------

.. image:: |BP_OPERATION_POWER_ASSET|
   :alt: |PRODUCT_NAME| POWER button operation.
   :width: 360px

| **On**
| Press once
| **Off**
| Press and hold for 3 seconds

.. list-table::
   :header-rows: 0
   :widths: 12 88

   * - **NOTE**
     - When using with |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|, you can control the power status (on or off) of |PRODUCT_NAME| through the main POWER button of |BP_HOST_PRODUCT_NAME|.

       The product will automatically shut down if it is not charged or no loads are connected for |DEFAULT_STANDBY_DURATION|.

LCD DISPLAY ON/OFF
------------------

.. image:: |BP_OPERATION_LCD_ASSET|
   :alt: |PRODUCT_NAME| LCD display operation.
   :width: 360px

When you press the main POWER button or when charging the product, the LCD display is illuminated. When you press it again, the LCD display will be switched off.
